text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
G-Good morning! So sorry for trouble yesterday……!
I'll do my absolute best t-today—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ……Small suggestion about that… if okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
…Umm. Had lot on shoulders yesterday, Rob Roy.
Planning, guiding, explaining, giving instructions…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How about I handle instructions?
Tell me what's needed, I can manage.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……Ah… Sorry. Umm… Thank you.
That really takes huge weight off my mind……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, leave it to me. I, uh…
pretty used to worrying about things myself.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay! Switch location marked and photographed! Show everyone once back!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Me and Rob Roy find second stone switch,
Dober's team does revenge match at Lonely River.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Such careful plan…
Hehe, classic Dober!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Honestly… huge relief.
…Ah, excuse me. Way back is… this… way…?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(……Oh dear. Check book to know for sure……
But can't pull it out here……)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Let's see…… this way……!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay and alrighty!

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Taiki
text_block_list.text:
―Gyaaaaaaah!
―Noooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
―……Ouch! No way, path turned into cliff～!
No way to climb back up from here.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: LANEing everyone now! \"HELP ME!\", send! ……Looking pale, Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
…I'm sorry, so sorry! If only I told truth…
Could've checked path in book…!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-Same yesterday, should've spoken up…!
No trouble if we just checked book beforehand—!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, calm down, Rob Roy! Okay?
Take it easy… tell me slow!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
…Story is picture book, not movie…
\"Rhodonite and Dream Stone\".

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Book……?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Told truth earlier…… prevented all this trouble.……
I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ………Aaah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's why familiar! Whole thing about that book!
Lonely River, Gille Dubh's Garden, Dreamstone……!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……Huh?
Y-You read book too, Taiki……?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Read together with friends back home! Loved it～!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ―Wait-wait-wait! Walking through world of that story right now?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Means… took tons of photos……!
―Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looking now, exactly how I pictured \"Lonely River\"!
Undine's Spring, forest, animals……!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Face tree, red mushrooms, from story too!
Wasn't cat wearing boots near red mushrooms?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, exact! Cait-sìth gathering!
Villagers asked to defeat kelpie!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Yes, yes! Invited to cat-sìth kingdom, that famous line—

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Taiki
text_block_list.text:
"特別に招待しよう。10ポンドでいい"
"Just for you, 10 pounds and you're in!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha……!
Sounds like that in Japanese!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Never imagined discussing books with you like this, Taiki……!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
…………
……Books truly are wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Why thought childish? Books cross borders, connect across time―)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Found ya!
Hoooi, okay over there?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Scared me good with sudden \"HELP ME!\".
Other two searching elsewhere, pinging them now!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Found us fast, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thought saw fairy in black clothes! Over this way, came closer, bam! Found ya!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Imagination maybe, but place full of mystery and fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not place regular umamusume like me usually ends up～
Really wanna watch that movie someday!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, um! Actually……!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Book, not movie?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ……E-Embarrassing, but thought movies seemed more grown-up……

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ……Hmm. Wanted to look grown-up, Rob Roy?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, just—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Classmates don't read picture books. All into makeup and grown things…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Got embarrassed…… talking about books.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ……Less \"grown-up\", more just liking makeup? Like you just like books, not childish. Right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ……Eh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Both great parts of who you are. Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Books or makeup… not super into anything myself. Both equally amazing to me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'd never look at campsite map and think \"just like story!\".

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So, yup! You're totally fine, Rob Roy! Right, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes, all ok!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. …All… fine……

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I see…… you're right……
